description: front view of a small ruined open-front lean-to shelter: two upright timber posts at the front, a sagging torn brown canvas roof sloping back, dark shadowed interior, seen from a high top-down three-quarter camera facing straight on, no side walls. Floating on a fully transparent background with no ground drawn at all: no grass, no dirt, no ground patch, no pedestal, only a thin dark contact shadow under the two posts
